name: Is it better to paint over minor drywall imperfections or repair them?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to paint over minor drywall imperfections or repair them?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is always better to repair minor drywall imperfections like small cracks or nail holes before painting. Painting directly over these issues will not hide them; in fact, it can make them more noticeable by drawing attention to the uneven surface. Properly repairing, patching, sanding, and priming the drywall creates a smooth, uniform surface that allows the new paint to adhere correctly and provides a professional, long-lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Always repair minor drywall imperfections before painting, as paint will not hide them and may highlight the flaws.
